title_records.text:
POV: ONE EPISODE TURNED
INTO THE WHOLE SEASON.

captions.speech_timing_source: Actual fitted speech transcribed by Groq Whisper with word timestamps
captions.source_of_geometry_bounds: Actual Blender build report; encoded pixel review has separately recorded scope

configured_identity.profile: Same young-adult male Peter; natural conversational English, clear medium-low register, consistent accent and timbre; emotions may vary without changing identity

cue_identity.profile: Same young-adult male Peter; natural conversational English, clear medium-low register, consistent accent and timbre; emotions may vary without changing identity

peter_voice_verification.evidence_scope: Voice ID, live gender catalogue, actual metadata and hashes; acoustic listening is separate

actual_render_times.timing_scope: Selected final two-plate version and final animation only; development/preview attempts excluded

protected_sources.comparison_policy: Exact binary bytes; text content permits CRLF/LF normalization only

visual_review_note: Actual decoded MP4 representatives inspected at 270px phone scale with simulated status, header, channel, subscribe and side-button overlays; frames 302 and 528 also inspected at full resolution. Titles and spoken captions are clear of these representative overlays; Peter face remains clear, background change and final freeze checked. No complete motion or phoneme accuracy review claimed.

encoded_video_visual_review.scope: Representative decoded MP4 frames; no complete motion or phoneme-sync review claimed

lip_sync_method: Measured 24fps RMS and word-based heuristic vowel/consonant visemes; not phoneme forced alignment

audio_choices.music: Original sparse warm two-note motif, then restrained accelerating ostinato; cut at dawn 15s
audio_choices.foley: Small remote/chime/countdown/clock accents; original morning bird chirps
audio_choices.punchline: Dry dialogue against silence; no busy sting or loud scratch obscuring the acting

limitations: Word/amplitude visemes estimate mouth timing; not phoneme forced alignment
Caption geometry comes from evaluated native build metadata; encoded frame review scope is recorded separately
No subjective audio listening review performed
